liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (4 reviews): Shakedown goes far out and is considered one of the better versions; Shakedown made the reviewer want to dance, despite not usually liking the song [7][10][11][15]
- **Row Jimmy** (3 reviews): Row Jimmy is called very nice, as is Brown Eyed Women; Claimed to be the longest Row Jimmy ever, at over eighteen minutes [10][14][16]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the download is worth it for Terrapin alone, along with Bertha; Echo effects are noted in Terrapin and Lost Sailor and the jam following [8][14]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy, Supplication and Samson are described as hot and fast with excellent Jerry guitar work [15]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Jerry plays hot on Minglewood and Bob sings solidly, apart from a patch in the middle [15]
- **Candyman** (1 review): The Candyman solo is singled out as very cool [7]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer counts Black Peter among favorite Dead tunes and enjoys hearing it here [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Encore Rap**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **gd79-12-09.sbd.miller.27751.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 183 min; rated 4.32/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is rated very high, surprising given the venue's poor reputation for sound; Sound quality is rated very good, around 4.5 stars; Jerry's vocals and Brent's keyboards sound mellow and warm in this recording [8][11][12]
- **gd79-12-09.aud-nak.warner.8833.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: The audience recording runs fast, which made it hard to use for patching the soundboard's tape flips [5]
- **gd1979-12-09.sbd.miller.108854.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1979-12-09.128713.naks.mason.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 180 min [3]

## Around the show

- Kiel Auditorium is described as a horrible venue acoustically [8]
- Reviewer finds Jerry's voice shaky, and loses interest in the show after Samson [10]
- Reviewer ranks it alongside Cornell 77 and places it in a personal top five including Red Rocks 78 and Veneta 72 [12]
- Reviewer had little interest in 1979 before, and calls this one of the best shows on the site [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-12-09.sbd.miller.27751.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard went to cassette master, then reel, then DAT, with a patch from a Nak 700 cassette and reel source; Transferred from Sony D8 DAT via RME Hammerfall into Samplitude, then FLAC; transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [1]
- **gd79-12-09.aud-nak.warner.8833.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [4]. Also: Audience source is a Nak recording, used by the reviewer to try patching tape flips in the soundboard [5]
- **gd1979-12-09.sbd.miller.108854.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [2]
- **gd1979-12-09.128713.naks.mason.flac16**: taped by Mason B. Taylor; source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones. Transferred on a Nak CR 7A [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks, Volume 47 (Kiel Auditorium, St. Louis, MO 12/9/79) 2023 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-47-kiel-auditorium-st-louis-mo-12-9-79-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2712510-844640) [18]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks, Volume 47 (Kiel Auditorium, St. Louis, MO 12/9/79) 2023 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-47-kiel-auditorium-st-louis-mo-12-9-79-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2712510-844640) [19]
- Poster by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_12.html) [20]
